title.en: Minimax H3 Max. One domino. It falls. Nothing happens. It gets back up.
title.zh: Minimax H3 Max. One domino. It falls. Nothing happens. It gets back up.

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 cinematic story prompt with attached video evidence from @GlennHasABeard.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3电影叙事提示词。

prompt:
"the domino slowly rises back up onto its end, pivoting on its base, until it is upright again"

Duration: 15s. Camera: locked, domino height.

"No others ever appear" is the consistency line. Every model wants to give a domino friends.
